newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaraguan man killed for gold teeth.
newsitem.headline: Nicaraguan man killed for gold teeth.

text.p: Nicaraguan police are searching for a man who killed his uncle in a failed attempt to steal his gold teeth, a local newspaper reported on Tuesday.
Francisco Javier Montalvan, 25, beat and kicked his uncle, Manuel Ignacio Montalvan, an auto parts salesman, while the victim was drunk last Oct. 23 in the capital, Managua, El Nuevo Diario reported.

"Francisco was looking for my brother to steal his gold teeth; he has about 10 of them. He found him in the street in the Rene Cisneros barrio ... and there he started kicking him," Filmon Montalvan told the newspaper.
The newspaper said the dead man suffered damage to his liver and kidney, three broken ribs and numerous blows to the mouth. But none of his gold teeth fell out.
